memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Where agents keep what they remember: backends are the databases, profiles are the stores an agent reads and writes. Saves go to the deployment config and open on the next runtime start.
memory.apiMissing: This runtime does not expose the Studio memory API yet; rebuild and restart AgentFlow, then reopen Memory.
memory.readOnlyMessage: This deployment has no editable config source, so memory cannot be changed from Studio.
memory.readOnlyBanner: This deployment has no editable config source for memory.
memory.source: {mode, select, configdir {source config directory} file {source config file} other {source {mode}}}
memory.deleteProfileMessage:
Delete memory profile "{name}" from the deployment config?

The stored records are not deleted.
memory.deleteBackendMessage:
Delete memory backend "{name}" from the deployment config?

The database itself and its records are not touched.
memory.profilesSubtitle: Named store sets agents pick in the builder, besides the built-in "conversational" one.
memory.profilesSubtitleBuiltin: Named store sets agents pick in the builder. The built-in "conversational" profile is used by {agents}.
memory.cannotDelete: Cannot delete {name}; it is used by {usedBy}.
memory.backendsSubtitle: The databases stores live in. Secrets are never shown; use ${VAR} or cred:<service> to keep them out of the file.
memory.builtinChipTitle: Not in the file: the runtime store, used while no backend is declared
memory.writeOutMainDb: Write main_db out to the config to change it
memory.providerHint.sqlite: A local SQLite file: key-value, full-text and brute-force vector search. No server needed.
memory.providerHint.postgres: A PostgreSQL server: key-value and full-text search, shared by every instance.
memory.providerHint.pgvector: PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension: everything postgres does, plus indexed vector search.
memory.providerHint.redis: A Redis server: key-value only, fast and shared.
memory.providerHint.redisvector: Redis Stack: key-value plus vector search.
memory.providerHint.qdrant: A Qdrant server: vector search at scale.
memory.providerHint.volatile: Process memory, lost on restart and shared by every session. Bound it with max entries or a store retention.
memory.usedBy.noAgent: not used by an agent yet
memory.backend.subtitle: A backend is a database the memory stores live in. Backends open when agentflow starts.
memory.backend.validText: Valid. Save it to open the backend on the next runtime start.
memory.backend.nameHint: Stores refer to the backend by name, so it cannot change later.
memory.backend.providerChanged: Changing provider drops the settings the old one used.
memory.backend.pathHint: A file path, relative to the config. Empty uses ./data/agentflow.db.
memory.backend.urlHint: {stored} Use ${VAR} or cred:<service> to keep the secret out of the file.
memory.backend.storedDisplay: Stored: {display}. Leave empty to keep it.
memory.backend.storedValue: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
memory.backend.vectorScanLimitHint: Rows a vector search may scan. Default 50000.
memory.backend.maxEntriesHint: Bounds memory. Without it every store on this backend needs a retention.
memory.backend.otherKeys: Also in the file and kept as they are: {keys}. Edit them in Config.
memory.backend.otherKeysPlain: Also in the file and kept as they are: {keys}. Edit them in Config.
memory.profile.subtitle: Agents name a profile with memory: <name>. The built-in plugins look for stores called dialogue, facts and semantic.
memory.profile.validText: Valid. Save it, then pick it for an agent in the builder after the next restart.
memory.profile.nameHint: Agents refer to the profile by name, so it cannot change later. "conversational" is the built-in one.
memory.profile.storesHint: Each logical store is a table on a backend. Retention is a duration such as 30d, or forever.
memory.profile.recallHint: plugin:recency reads dialogue and facts; plugin:semantic searches the semantic store by meaning.
memory.profile.writeHint: Passed to loops as agent.info().memory.write. memory.write always runs the routing table, so leave it as plugin:routing_table.
memory.profile.embedHint: Embeds each record on write, for semantic search.
memory.profile.embedHintSemantic: Required for semantic recall: it embeds each record on write and each query.
memory.profile.embedHintAlways: Embeds each record on write; required for semantic recall.
memory.profile.rerankHint: Optional: oversample vector hits and let a provider: rerank model order them.
memory.profile.oversampleHint: How many times k vector hits to rerank. Default 4.
memory.profile.oversampleHintAlways: With a rerank model: how many times k hits to rerank. Default 4.
memory.store.windowTitle: How many recent records recall returns
memory.store.scopeTitle: Rows are kept per user by default; whole agent shares one set across users
memory.store.poolTitle: A named shared pool from Tenancy; replaces the scope
